known_limitations: orig_no_match: original rule cannot match even the explicitly-hydrogenated donor (pre-existing aromatic/kekule, charge, or chain-length impedance; unaffected by re-encoding).

residual_H_query: reactant still holds a [#1,...] list element or a recursive $(...[H]) query that the H-node strip does not remove; these cannot match implicit H (separate latent issue, out of scope for the H-node re-encoding).

reencode_gen_failure: minority of rules lose a product or fail product generation (RDKit RunReactants implicit-H/chiral-stereo interaction at the reaction center, and mapped-H hydrogen-transfer semantics needing explicit Hn-equivalence). Failed products are dropped (fail-closed), never emitted with wrong valence.
method: reference = original SMIRKS applied to AddHs(donor) then RemoveHs+canonical; candidate = re-encoded SMIRKS applied to implicit donor; fidelity = reference products are a subset of candidate products (no loss).
